notes: Keelpad (KEEL) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the factory at launch. Transfers have no token fee or burn, and there are no external minting or administrative functions. No application contracts are included. The pool pairs with IMD; initialPrice is provenance only, and the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
